newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Tanzania shilling down on pound, stable on dollar.
newsitem.headline: Tanzania shilling down on pound, stable on dollar.

text.p: The Tanzanian shilling weakened against the pound on Friday but remained stable against the dollar, central Bank of Tanzania (BoT) officials said.
Against the pound, the shilling was posted at a mean rate of 925.4733 compared to 923.6140 on Thursday. Against the dollar, the shilling was unchanged at a mean rate of 590.7330.

Assessing the shilling's performance this week, a dealer at at a major foreign bank said the state-owned National Bank of Commerce (NBC) had been active in trying to force the shilling rate versus the dollar at around 597 but had failed.
The dealer said there had been insufficient dollar demand and the NBC push had faltered.
